items.prompt: Redraw ONE landscape premium ability card, 16:9. Image 1 is the NAI5 composition draft ONLY: retain low angle, foreground reaching palm, other hand on chest, wind-swept teal cape and braid, immense single pale turquoise wind arc and ivory-gold opening against a deep dark abstract background. Image 2 (holy shield) controls Xingyue's FACE DESIGN AND DRAWING STYLE: copy that restrained anime face construction, shape of golden eyes and eyelids, calm unsmiling expression, straight fringe, light blonde locks and white crescent clip lying at viewer-right temple. Image 3 (holy healing) controls the tactile PAINT HANDLING of hair, cloth and background. These two existing cards are the aesthetic standard. Repaint the draft rather than merely adding texture. Her calm face has simple warm pale skin shapes, minimal nose and mouth, NO makeup blush, shiny nose dot, glossy lips or soft beauty rendering. Face detail is restrained and drawn, eyes gold and readable; slightly parted mouth for a quiet chant. Large opaque strokes, chunky continuous cloth planes, matte deep teal with chromatic shadows, ivory gown, sparse dull-gold trim; brush edges and uneven selective linework like images 2 and 3. Light blonde hair has coherent locks and broad painted shadows, spare highlights, no fine strand web or shiny streaks. Keep the immense cape and wind shapes graphically bold, strong dark-light separation; reduce sparkle and glossy glowing outlines so the character and gesture command the picture. One thick low braid, white gold-trimmed priestess robe and deep teal cape. Exactly TWO arms: one believable open palm reaching lower-left with FIVE fingers, other bent to chest; remove the draft's stray flesh-colored hanging shape on lower right. No duplicate hands. Crescent clip white as in holy shield, not a halo; no copying shield, golden card, prayer pose or background composition from style references. No text, UI, borders or watermark. This must visibly belong to the same hand-painted card set as images 2 and 3, with their face proportions and quiet matte paint surfaces.

portrait.prompt: Restyle and redraw ONE full-body character-selection portrait of Xingyue. IMAGE 3, holy-healing card, controls the tactile matte hand-painted hair and cloth. IMAGE 4 is the newly redrawn ability card, coordinating the same face design and painted palette. Deliver a full-body vertical 2:3 portrait, head, all hair, lantern, both hands, gown and boots fully inside canvas with modest clean white margins. Preserve target's standing silhouette and gestures: one hand near chest in a calm blessing, opposite hand holding the lantern handle to side; lantern hangs naturally clear of skirt. Preserve its one single extremely long LOW BRAID curving behind hips with free tail, WHITE solid crescent hair clip on VIEWER RIGHT lying flat into hair just above bangs; golden eyes, pale blonde hair and quiet unsmiling adult anime face. Keep ivory white long-sleeved high-neck priestess robe, muted deep teal gold-edged shoulder cape, simple gold star motif on robe, charcoal cuffs, white-gray boots. Do not copy card shield, glowing square, windstorm, foreshortened reaching arm or card's cropped framing. PAINT DIRECTLY IN THE SAME STYLE AS CARDS 2 AND 3: clear matte opaque color masses, directional broad brushwork and hard-edged connected shadow planes, selective fine drawn contours at eyes, fingertips, collar and seams; calm face skin with almost flat warm pale colors, small fringe shadow and subtle neck shadow, sharply designed gold irises but few details. No cosmetic blush, bright nose dot, glossy lips, photorealistic face or plastic rendering. discarded_clothing_correction.prompt: Precise local edit of this Xingyue full-body selection portrait. CHANGE ONLY CLOTHING AND BOOTS. The fabric and boots currently contain too many unrelated dabs and fragmented patches. Rebuild the robe, cape and footwear with clean coherent construction and controlled shading that matches the quieter face. Ivory robe: long uninterrupted hanging fold planes from waist toward hem, connected broad shadows following gravity, clear layered skirt edges, clean sleeve tubes with only a few major compression folds at elbows/cuffs. Deep teal cape: calm continuous cloth surfaces, several large readable folds and subtle material variation. Keep gold edging as clean consistent narrow bands and retain existing gold star accents, belt/clasp, charcoal cuffs and exact outfit silhouette. Eliminate scattered polygon chips, scratchy short streaks, excessive smeared brush dabs and mottled dirty patches throughout clothes. Boots: readable paired white-gray ankle boots with charcoal fold-over cuffs, simple coherent uppers, natural ankle creases, distinct toe boxes, tidy gray soles and stable heel shapes. Clean solid footwear surfaces with a few soft shadows and selected crisp seams, not marble-like fragments or piles of paint. Keep both feet and all hems inside the frame. Face and hair unchanged. One finished vertical 2:3 illustration, plain white background, no text, border or watermark.

superseded_card_redraw.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, redraw a premium ability-card illustration. Image 1 is the NAI5 COMPOSITION DRAFT and primary redraw target; image 2 is Xingyue's CURRENT APPROVED light-priest identity reference only. Deliver one finished landscape illustration, preserve the draft's wide 16:9 view, low-angle commanding medium close-up, central-right character, enlarged open hand in lower-left foreground, other hand near sternum, enormous wind-swept deep-teal cape and low thick braid streaming to the right, monumental ivory-gold opening and turquoise arc diagonally behind her. Increase the heroic scale and visual sophistication through a clear silhouette, controlled dark teal shadows, concentrated warm ivory-gold light on face and outstretched palm, gold rim light on cape, quiet deep midnight negative space at upper left; large shapes and restrained sparse flecks, no particle clutter or decorative frame. She channels a vast restorative wind with a quiet softly singing mouth and composed, slightly detached gold-eyed gaze, not anger or an exaggerated smile. Match identity reference: pale blonde hair, NEAT STRAIGHT FRINGE across forehead, long side locks, one SINGLE very long thick LOW BRAID, not swept center-part bangs or a high ponytail. White solid C-shaped crescent hair clip lies FLAT into hair just above fringe on VIEWER RIGHT, its tips point toward upper-right as in reference; do not turn it into a halo. White high-neck gold-edged priestess gown, dark teal gold-edged shoulder cape, dark wrist cuffs and BARE HANDS. Correct anatomy to EXACTLY TWO connected arms and two hands: one arm reaches toward viewer, other bends to chest; remove the extra skin-colored dangling arm-like shape at lower right in the draft. Foreground palm has five naturally articulated fingers with believable foreshortening, chest hand reads as a gentle invocation gesture. Keep face and palms unobstructed by effects. Retain draft's giant single curved wind current behind silhouette, a large organic flowing band of pale turquoise light, not multiple symmetrical rings. REDRAW IN CURRENT GAME STYLE: hand-painted Japanese anime, opaque layered color blocks, firm light-shadow boundaries and directional brushwork; large calm chromatic-gray masses alternating with selectively dense cloth planes. Hair stays coherent and flowing with clean continuous base colors, long grouped shadows and broad luminous bands, selective tapered separation lines, no shredded triangular hair. Cloth has sculptural weight, tension and varied fold planes, matte chromatic dark teal; preserve a few gold edges rather than intricate ornamental patterns. Anime face has defined lids and layered gold irises, economical nose and mouth, warm quiet skin, no shiny nose tip. Selective hand-drawn contours vary in weight and disappear into paint around quieter areas; no glossy airbrush, no uniform sharp line-art everywhere, no grain filter. No text, UI, border, watermark. Do not copy reference standing pose, white backdrop, or lantern.
